description: Daily Ethereum series computed by X PrimeFlow on its own execution (geth) and beacon (lighthouse) nodes: ETH burned, base fee, gas, blob fees, validators and staked ETH, stablecoin supply on L1 and ETH held in L2 bridges. Returns the latest values or one series with up to 365 daily points, with asOf and age.

days.description: How many latest daily points to return (1–365).

metric.description: One daily series. Omit to get the latest value of every series.
